snippet.title: After the First Station - PC Full Playthrough [1440p 60FPS] (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Holding the "W" key until my wrist snaps in half in this heart-felt walking simulator about growing up and finding yourself.

Part of my "Braving the Backlog" series where I aim to try out every digital game I own. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1fy8ZKpYEEU&list=PLOFaOI1gkt-AUJ8JSm6mP6Zw5WB0JqGwZ

After the First Station was developed and published by Lsgamedev in 2021.

It is available on Windows PCs.
